# Click on the right panel background (black area)
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 30, 'col': 48}])
print(f"Click right panel background: board_changed={result.get('board_changed')}, gameplay_changed={result.get('gameplay_changed')}")

# Check what changed
if result.get('board_changed'):
    t = last_transition
    before_lines = t.before_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    after_lines = t.after_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    for i, (bl, al) in enumerate(zip(before_lines, after_lines)):

print(f"Level completed: {result.get('level_completed')}")
print(f"Done: {result.get('done')}")

# Try moving N left
result2 = action(['LEFT'])
print(f"\nMove N left: board_changed={result2.get('board_changed')}")
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'N':
        r1, c1 = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']), min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
        print(f"  N now at: [{r1},{c1}]")
print(f"Level completed: {result2.get('level_completed')}")

</function>
